species.name: Crappie
why: Water 71°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 2–10 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 71°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 2–10 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 14 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
